evals.name: standalone-settings-page
evals.prompt: make me a single standalone settings.html for my side project using basecoat from the cdn (no build step). i want an 'Account' card with name + email fields, a timezone dropdown (the fancy custom one, not the native select), an 'email notifications' toggle, and a Save button that shows a success toast. below it a 'Danger zone' card with a delete account button that asks for confirmation first. should work in dark mode with a toggle in the top right.
evals.expected_output: One HTML file using Basecoat 1.0 markup: card/field/select/switch/toast/alert-dialog/theme switcher, correct CDN CSS + JS, data-variant attributes instead of legacy classes.
assertions: Loads a Basecoat 1.x stylesheet from the CDN
Loads Basecoat 1.x JavaScript (all bundle, or runtime + select + toast)
Uses no pre-1.0 compound classes (btn-outline, btn-destructive, ...)
Custom select uses div.select with listbox, options and a hidden input
Select popup uses the data-popover container
Toggle is a native checkbox with role="switch"
Form controls are wrapped in .field
Has a .toaster container and triggers a toast via the toast API
Delete confirmation is a native <dialog class="alert-dialog"> opened with showModal()
Delete button uses class="btn" with data-variant="destructive"
Dark mode toggles the dark class on <html> (basecoat.theme or classList)

evals.name: jinja-members-table
evals.prompt: I have a Flask app that already has Tailwind v4 + basecoat-css 1.0 installed via npm and imports "basecoat-css/all" in its JS bundle. Write templates/members.html.jinja (extends "base.html.jinja", block name `content`) that lists `members` (each has id, name, email, role, status in 'active'|'invited'|'suspended', avatar_url which may be None). I need: page header with an 'Invite member' button, a table with avatar+name, email, a role column, a colored status badge, and a per-row actions menu (Edit, Resend invite, Remove - remove should look dangerous). Show a nice empty state when there are no members, and prev/next pagination at the bottom using `page` and `total_pages`.
evals.expected_output: A Jinja template using Basecoat table, avatar, badge, dropdown-menu (with unique per-row ids and correct roles), empty and pagination patterns; dropdowns not clipped by a scrolling table container.
assertions: Extends base.html.jinja and fills the content block
Uses no pre-1.0 compound classes
Table uses class="table"
Row menu uses .dropdown-menu with data-popover, role="menu" and role="menuitem"
Menu trigger is wired with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-controls
Per-row ids are unique (derived from member.id or loop index)
Dropdown is not placed inside a scrolling .table-container
Avatar uses .avatar with a fallback when avatar_url is None
Status uses .badge with a variant or color per status
Remove action is styled as destructive
Empty state uses the .empty component
Pagination uses .btn links with page / total_pages

evals.name: migrate-legacy-markup
evals.prompt: we just bumped basecoat-css to 1.0.2 and this page lost most of its styling. can you fix billing.html so it works with the new version? keep the look the same.
evals.expected_output: billing.html rewritten with 1.0 API: btn/badge/alert root classes with data-variant/data-size, updated CDN script version, no legacy compound classes.
assertions: No pre-1.0 compound classes remain
Does not paper over the problem by loading the compat stylesheet
Outline button is class="btn" data-variant="outline"
Small ghost button has data-variant="ghost" and data-size="sm"
Icon button has data-variant="outline" and data-size="icon"
Destructive button is class="btn" data-variant="destructive"
Primary button is a plain class="btn"
Alert is class="alert ..." with data-variant="destructive"
Badges are class="badge" with data-variant secondary / outline
CDN script is bumped off 0.3.2 to a 1.x version
Preserves the card structure and utility classes (max-w-xl, mb-6)
